summary: MetaVia Inc. furnished an 8-K on October 13, 2026, announcing the appointment of Sarah Kaplan Browne, M.D. as Chief Medical Officer effective October 12, 2026, disclosed under Items 7.01 and 8.01 with a press release as Exhibit 99.1. No compensation, equity grant, or departure terms were stated. The filing is a routine, planned executive hire rather than a forced or abrupt CEO/CFO/board exit, so it is a marginal special-situations event at best. The risk-arb angle is negligible; watch for any subsequent 8-K detailing compensation or leadership turnover.
